title: DependencyType stubs and gencode are regenerated via dev/generate_protos.py, not hand-edited
answers: how do I regenerate the databricks uc registry protobuf python files
I changed the proto enum, how do I update _pb2.py and _pb2.pyi
why does lint-proto or buf fail after editing databricks_uc_registry_messages.proto
which protoc version generates the mlflow protos
body:
Edit the source .proto (mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages.proto), then regenerate with dev/generate_protos.py so the output uses the repository's pinned protoc and mypy-protobuf toolchain.
The generated pair mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages_pb2.py and databricks_uc_registry_messages_pb2.pyi must change together; the .pyi enum wrapper lists every enum member, so a new value must appear in both _DependencyTypeEnumTypeWrapper and the module-level constants.
Do not hand-edit the _pb2 files. Check the result by importing the regenerated module and round-tripping the new enum value, then run lint-proto and buf.
applies: Any change to mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages.proto and its generated Python.
says: Support new model dependency types within the catalog model registry integration.
Type checking fails after adding a new dependency enum value for model registries.
Ensure generated interface stubs match updated model registry dependency protocol specifications.
Pull request verification fails protocol buffer linting when updating registry message formats.
search: Python protobuf stubs and generated code for DependencyType must be rebuilt using dev/generate_protos.py rather than edited manually. After modifying mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages.proto, the pinned protoc and mypy-protobuf toolchain must update both mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages_pb2.py and databricks_uc_registry_messages_pb2.pyi together, reflecting new enum entries in _DependencyTypeEnumTypeWrapper and module constants. Verification requires importing the module to round-trip new values and passing lint-proto and buf checks, applying strictly to Databricks UC registry message proto definitions.
